summary: @ornikar/graphql-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook `node setup.mjs` that fetches the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun) into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle featuring a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift-rotation, `n7gIxM` numeric constant table, `hc1jfK9` decoder). `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifier renaming and per-call string maps typical of obfuscator.io. The advertised purpose of the package is a small GraphQL validation CLI; that purpose does not require downloading an alternate language runtime or executing an obfuscated payload with it. Delivering the payload through Bun rather than Node means the executed code never runs under the Node interpreter and is opaque to Node-only inspection. The @ornikar-scoped name combined with a preinstall runtime-dropper that is unrelated to the declared GraphQL tooling is consistent with scope impersonation or a compromised publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
